After integrating conduction by parts, the volume contribution is the integral over the
domain of conductivity times the temperature gradient dotted with the test-function gradient.
The inward prescribed core flux contributes negatively on $\Gamma_q$. Convection contributes
positively as $h(T-T_\infty)$ times the test function on $\Gamma_h$. The test function vanishes
on the prescribed-temperature boundary, and the insulated boundary contributes nothing.
